webcam_observations: RGB565 blank at 18.75 MHz; switching to RGB666 restores image at same clock. This supersedes earlier RGB565 qualifications.
RGB666 SPI 75 MHz corrupts pixels, including fast-slew/8mA GPIO trial.
RGB666 PIO 50 MHz displays full-screen and smaller-viewport gameplay without the observed corruption.
limits: 50 MHz exceeds nominal panel serial clock specification; empirical qualification on this board only.
No TE synchronization or guarantee against scanout tearing.
Webcam snapshots establish image correctness, not precise optical frame-rate measurement; fps comes from completed display transfers.
